fields.prompt_precision: The view factor to twelve decimals

fix.display: /root/wt-b5-nextgen/src/components/course/panels/consequence/FireExplorer.jsx:146 -> make the Heat view take the Flame view's pool inputs (fuel, diameter, wind, viscosity, heat of combustion, radiative and soot fractions) instead of erhaArgs(), so it prints Fmax (twelve) and the heat flux (six) from the unrounded chain; alternatively print flame length and tilt to twelve decimals at FireExplorer.jsx:62-63

fields.recommendation: Display fix (Heat view driven by the learner's pool). The tolerance alternative would be about 2.5e-9 (sensitivities: 1.6e-9 for half a unit in L, 3.1e-10 for half a unit in tilt), which throws away the twelve-decimal design the wave chose for this class.
fields.evidence: The View view takes flame length and tilt as TYPED numbers, and the Flame view prints them to six decimals only. Running the engine on the printed L = 20.618159 m and tilt = 53.023688 deg gives Fmax 0.046024297336 against expected 0.046024298275 (difference 9.4e-10, tol 5e-13). The Heat view that chains unrounded is hard-wired to ERHA (FireExplorer.jsx:146 erhaArgs()), so it cannot be set to YOKRI.
fields.notes: The capstone brief (intermediate/m06.../l04-the-capstone-brief.md) tells the learner to 'carry the flame length and tilt into the view factor view' and 'round nothing on the way', which the six-decimal print makes impossible. A learner who follows the brief fails.

fields.source_ref: /root/wt-b5-nextgen/src/components/course/panels/consequence/FireExplorer.jsx:161 (Heat view, ERHA only) / hand calc q = tau SEP Fmax

fix.display: /root/wt-b5-nextgen/src/components/course/panels/consequence/FireExplorer.jsx:146 -> Heat view driven by the learner's pool inputs (same change as yokri_view_factor_max), printing six(r.heatFluxWM2) for YOKRI directly

fields.recommendation: Same display fix as the view factor; one change repairs both. Tolerance alternative would be about 6e-5 W/m2.
fields.evidence: The Heat view is fixed to ERHA (FireExplorer.jsx:146 base = erhaArgs(); only distance and tau are editable), so YOKRI's flux must be multiplied by hand from the printed SEP and the View view's Fmax. With the Fmax the panel yields (see view factor), 0.765 x 37784.162898 x 0.046024297336 = 1330.327004 against expected 1330.327031 (difference 2.7e-5, tol 5e-7). With an exact Fmax the hand product would pass (2.5e-8).
fields.notes: Defect is inherited from the view factor chain.

fields.evidence: The probit view takes psig, so the learner divides 65000 Pa by PA_PER_PSI as the brief says (advanced/m06.../l04-the-capstone-brief.md:24). Full-precision psig reproduces the answer exactly; psig typed to six decimals moves it by 2.5e-9, well inside tol 5e-7.
fields.notes: Four-decimal psig would move it by 2.5e-6 and fail; the brief says to divide, and a calculator gives full precision.
